'''2007 Match Play Championship Day 1 Nate Meeker DS Jabba's Palace: Lower Passages''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Nate Meeker]] at [[2007 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Deck name:''' Dark Side Fun Deck for Jared Lockwood
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
